name: The Flying Machine Airport
label: Quest
description: Tasked by Apothecary Zamah from Thunder Bluff, Horde adventurers hunt down a hidden Venture Company landing pad nestled above Stonetalon Mountains.…

clips.title: The story
paras: Tasked by Apothecary Zamah from Thunder Bluff, Horde adventurers hunt down a hidden Venture Company landing pad nestled above Stonetalon Mountains. Carrying an alchemical Toxic Fogger, operatives must slip into the heart of the goblin logging operations to gas their air transit hub. The mission strikes directly at the cartel's communications while underscoring the ruthless methods of the Royal Apothecary Society.

While the tauren seek to protect Stonetalon from deforestation and ravaging machinery, the Forsaken bring an entirely different philosophy to the front. Apothecary Zamah readies Apothecary Lydon's toxin to disrupt the Venture Company's logistics. Rather than attacking foot soldiers or loggers directly, she targets the cartel's link to the outside world: a rumored copter pad used to ferry light cargo and messages between Stonetalon and distant corporate offices.

Hidden high in the Cragpool Lake area south of the great waterwheel sits the Venture Company's copter pad, perched above the soot and chopped timber. It is small, meant for lightweight flying machines rather than massive zeppelins. Setting off the Toxic Fogger directly upon the pad ensures that any pilot, courier, or mechanic operating the machinery is smothered in toxic vapor before they can alert their commanders.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The toxin is ready. All that remains is its delivery. You, friend, must make that delivery.

The Venture Company must have a means of sending messages and light cargo between its headquarters and its operations in Stonetalon. It is likely a small sky port -- not big enough for a zeppelin, but perhaps for a flying machine. You must search the areas in Stonetalon under control of the Venture Company and find this sky port, if it exists. If you find it, then place the toxin there.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You must find the Venture Company airport if it exists, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You found the port? Well done, friend! I am sure the goblins were quite surprised from your delivery! Let us hope that toxin finds its way to their headquarters.
You have served your people well, and I advise you to ignore any guilt you might harbor for poisoning the Venture Company. They are deserving of far worse.
And if there is one mote of wisdom the Forsaken might teach its allies, it is this:
Do not shy from dark paths... If those paths lead to victory.
